meta.about: High-frequency function words per language, space-separated, lowercase, NFC. Read by src/core/text/language.ts; a word listed by several languages counts as a fraction for each.
meta.distinctiveCharacters: Letters that occur in one language of the set and rarely in the others; each occurrence adds a small bonus.
